title: CC4Q Workbench: From Quantum Repositories to Analyzable Code Comments
abstract: arXiv:2610.32651v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantum software development kits (SDKs) expose high-level APIs whose use requires an understanding of underlying mathematical principles, circuit semantics, and hardware properties. Code comments can provide natural-language or structural explanations that are not explicit in API calls. However, studying comments in a new quantum SDK still requires researchers to coordinate separate steps for comment extraction, quantum-specific classification, and manual verification, resulting in repeated integration effort. To address this problem, we present CC4Q Workbench, an open-source workbench that integrates these steps into a reusable workflow. Given a Python repository at a specified revision, CC4Q Workbench automatically extracts code-comment pairs, segments comments into sentence-level units, and applies two trained classifiers to identify quantum-specific content and assign quantum-knowledge categories. translated_title: CC4Q 工作台：从量子代码仓库到可分析的代码注释
translated_abstract: 量子软件开发工具包（SDK）提供了高级 API，其使用需要理解底层数学原理、电路语义和硬件特性。代码注释能够提供 API 调用中未明确表达的自然语言或结构化解释。然而，研究新量子 SDK 中的注释仍需要研究者协调注释提取、量子特定内容分类和人工验证等相互独立的步骤，导致重复的集成工作。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 CC4Q Workbench，这是一个开源工作台，将这些步骤整合为可复用的工作流程。给定指定版本的 Python 仓库，CC4Q Workbench 会自动提取代码-注释对，将注释切分为句子级单元，并应用两个经过训练的分类器来识别量子特定内容并分配量子知识类别。其网页界面支持探索性（分析）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了开源工作台 CC4Q Workbench，它能自动从量子 SDK 的 Python 仓库中提取代码-注释对、将注释切分为句子级单元，并通过训练好的分类器识别量子特定内容及其知识类别，把分散的注释研究步骤整合为可复用的工作流程。
en_tdlr: CC4Q Workbench is an open-source workbench that automatically extracts code-comment pairs from quantum SDK Python repositories, segments comments into sentence-level units, and applies trained classifiers to identify quantum-specific content and quantum-knowledge categories, integrating these scattered steps into a reusable workflow.
